<title level="1" right="Class Feature 3">[Opportune Riposte](/Classes.aspx?ID=15)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Advanced Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=39) pg. 82

**Class** Swashbuckler
</column>

---

You turn the tables on foes who fumble, capitalizing immediately on their mistake. You gain the Opportune Riposte reaction.
